title: /moreabout walks and signals in codemother's own trees
intention: /moreabout's expand() and signal() default to owner 'codemother', so the walk and the write-back reach codemother_<nexus>_nodes.
why: Measured 2026-11-05: skills/moreabout/moreabout.py OWNER = 'chart' is the default owner of expand() and signal(). The parent 2b3d842bc118 moves codemother's learning to codemother_<nexus>_nodes and drops the chart-named tables (Akien 2026-11-05: 'codemother's learning goes in its own tables'); left on 'chart', /moreabout would walk an empty table. Children prove before parents.
traces_to: Law 6 via parent 2b3d842bc118 (codemother owns her learning); RULE 1 (this reader's change lives in skills/moreabout).
how: Set OWNER = 'codemother' in skills/moreabout/moreabout.py; point the existing test_chart_moreabout.py's owner-bearing calls at moreabout.OWNER; red-first proof skills/moreabout/proofs/test_moreabout_reads_codemothers_tree.py.

clauses.claim: moreabout.OWNER is 'codemother' and expand() and signal() default their owner to it
a node deposited into a codemother-owned scratch nexus is seen by expand() called with no owner
signal() called with no owner grows codemother_<scratch>_nodes by one and mints no chart_<scratch>_nodes

decisions.text: D1: red-first proof skills/moreabout/proofs/test_moreabout_reads_codemothers_tree.py, one tooth per clause, scratch nexi through tree.scratch_nexus(owner='codemother'); red at HEAD 2026-11-05.
D3: test_chart_moreabout.py's nexus_table, deposit_learning and tree_state calls pass owner=moreabout_mod.OWNER, so the existing proof follows the default it exercises.

measured.saw: OWNER = "chart" at skills/moreabout/moreabout.py:47, the default of expand() and signal()
measured.how: grep -n OWNER skills/moreabout/moreabout.py; the red-first proof: all three teeth FAIL at HEAD
